description: List GA4 account summaries accessible to the authenticated user. Each summary includes the account plus a lightweight list of its property summaries (property ID + display name). Best starting point to discover available GA4 accounts and properties. Read-only.

maxPages.description: Maximum number of API pages to fetch (default 50). If more pages remain, the result includes truncated:true and a nextPageToken.

pageToken.description: Continuation token to resume listing from a previous truncated result.

name: ga4_account_summaries_list
